headline: Israeli strike hits Doctors Without Borders clinic in Gaza k!lling two staff members
label: BREAKING
caption:
Two Doctors Without Borders employees have been k!lled after an Israeli strike directly hit a clinic in Gaza. 🚨

According to Doctors Without Borders, an Israeli strike directly hit one of its clinics in the Gaza Strip on Friday night, k!lling two watchmen.

The medical charity stated that the building was clearly marked with logos and that its precise location had been shared with the Israeli military.

The organization noted that this latest attack brings the total number of its staff members k!lled by Israeli forces in Gaza to 17.

The strike occurred near al Shifa Hospital and contributed to a total de@th toll of eight across Gaza on Friday, according to local reports.
